## MGIT Students and Faculty Conduct Household Survey in Adopted Village Under Unnat Bharat Abhiyan Scheme

News Date : 17 Feb 2023News ReportAs part of the Unnat Bharat Abhiyan scheme launched by the Government of India, the Ministry of Human Resource Development, the faculty and students of MGIT carried out a household survey in Mirzaguda, RR District. The program aimed to identify the needs of the village’s residents, which are to be fulfilled in addition to the existing facilities.The village sarpanch, Mr. Ravinder Goud, panchayat secretary, and ward members participated in the survey, contributing to the successful completion of the program. The initiative is part of MGIT’s commitment to promoting the holistic development of rural India and creating a better future for the country’s citizens.
